content: Use this medication on the skin only, as directed by your doctor, typically two or three times daily. The dosage and duration of treatment depend on the type of infection being treated. Apply a sufficient amount of the powder to lightly coat the affected area and some of the surrounding skin. After applying the medication, wash your hands unless you are using it to treat your hands. Do not wrap, cover, or bandage the treated area unless instructed to do so by your doctor. Use this medication consistently to achieve the best results. Continue using it for the full prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve after a few days. Skin irritation or redness may occur as side effects. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Before using nystatin, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk for serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of the next dose, skip the missed dose and use your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
